name: AutoTrader
summary: This EA is a session-based trading toggle utility that automatically enables or disables the MetaTrader AutoTrading button (Ctrl+E) based on a user-defined time window. Outside the active trading session, it also closes all open positions. It does not generate its own trade signals or open positions based on a strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于时段的交易开关工具，根据用户设定的时间窗口自动启用或禁用MetaTrader的自动交易按钮（Ctrl+E）。在活跃交易时段之外，它还会平掉所有持仓。它不会根据策略自行产生交易信号或开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于时间段来控制交易系统的启用和禁用，而非基于市场技术指标产生交易信号。入场条件方面，当当前时间进入用户设定的起始时间（默认9:30）且自动交易未开启时，EA通过模拟键盘按键Ctrl+E来开启自动交易。出场条件方面，当当前时间超出交易时段时，EA会遍历所有持仓并逐个平仓，同时关闭自动交易功能。仓位管理方面，该EA没有任何仓位管理逻辑，它只是简单地关闭所有持仓而不考虑仓位大小或盈亏状态。资金管理方面，同样没有任何资金管理机制，平仓是无差别执行的所有持仓平仓操作。整体而言，这是一个纯工具型EA，依赖Windows API的keybd_event函数来模拟键盘操作，存在平台依赖性和可靠性风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to control the enabling and disabling of the trading system based on a time window, rather than generating trade signals from market technical indicators. For entry conditions, when the current time enters the user-defined start time (default 9:30) and AutoTrading is disabled, the EA simulates the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+E via the Windows API to enable AutoTrading. For exit conditions, when the current time falls outside the trading session, the EA iterates through all open positions and closes each one, while also disabling AutoTrading. Regarding position sizing, the EA has no position management logic whatsoever; it simply closes all positions without considering position size or profit/loss status. For money management, there is similarly no money management mechanism—the position closing is indiscriminately executed across all holdings. Overall, this is a purely utility-type EA that relies on the Windows API keybd_event function to simulate keyboard input, introducing platform dependency and reliability concerns.
pros: 时间控制逻辑完善，支持跨午夜时段判断
实现简洁，代码量小，易于理解和修改
自动平仓功能可防止非交易时段持仓风险
pros_en: Well-implemented time control logic with support for overnight session boundaries
Simple and concise implementation, easy to understand and modify
Automatic position closing prevents risk of holding positions outside trading hours
cons: 依赖Windows user32.dll的keybd_event函数，无法在非Windows平台运行
使用键盘模拟方式切换自动交易状态极不可靠，可能因窗口焦点问题失败
平仓操作无滑点保护、无错误处理、无仓位筛选，可能部分平仓失败
没有检测新K线机制，每个Tick都会执行检查造成不必要的资源消耗
Sleep函数在EA中不推荐使用，可能导致线程阻塞
cons_en: Depends on Windows user32.dll keybd_event function, cannot run on non-Windows platforms
Keyboard simulation approach to toggle AutoTrading is highly unreliable and may fail due to window focus issues
Position closing has no slippage protection, no error handling, and no position filtering—partial closures may fail
No new bar detection mechanism; checks are performed on every tick causing unnecessary resource consumption
Use of Sleep function is not recommended in EAs and may cause thread blocking
improvements: 使用MQL5原生的TerminalInfoInteger和账户权限API替代keybd_event键盘模拟，提升跨平台兼容性和可靠性
增加平仓的错误处理和重试机制，添加仓位筛选（如按品种、按盈亏）功能，并加入新K线检测以减少不必要的计算
improvements_en: Replace keybd_event keyboard simulation with MQL5 native TerminalInfoInteger and account permission APIs to improve cross-platform compatibility and reliability
Add error handling and retry logic for position closing, implement position filtering (e.g., by symbol, by P&L), and add new bar detection to reduce unnecessary computation

risk_points: keybd_event键盘模拟可能因窗口焦点丢失而失效，导致交易状态未正确切换
平仓操作无错误处理，在快速行情中可能因重新报价或滑点导致平仓失败
非交易时段无条件平掉所有持仓，可能违背用户在其他EA上的持仓意图
risk_points_en: keybd_event keyboard simulation may fail if MetaTrader loses window focus, leaving trading state incorrectly toggled
Position closing lacks error handling; during volatile markets, requote or slippage may cause closure failures
Indiscriminately closing all positions outside trading hours may conflict with positions intended by other EAs

summary_en: This EA is a session-based trading toggle utility that automatically enables or disables the MetaTrader AutoTrading button (Ctrl+E) based on a user-defined time window. Outside the active trading session, it also closes all open positions. It does not generate its own trade signals or open positions based on a strategy.
